name: Phase 10 Market Decay & Stabilisation
description: Deterministic market state decay to prevent permanent price drift

archived_legacy_suites.name: Market State Decay Cycle Tests
archived_legacy_suites.description: Tests for deterministic decay of port and cluster market states

tests.name: Decay disabled: state unchanged
tests.description: When market.dynamic_pricing_enabled=false, decay should be no-op

args.query: SELECT COUNT(*) as cnt FROM port_commodity_state
SELECT COUNT(*) as cnt FROM port_commodity_state

tests.name: Port rolling_volume decay when enabled
tests.description: Rolling volume should decay by multiplier after cron runs

args.query: INSERT INTO port_commodity_state (port_id, commodity_code, rolling_volume, stock_level) VALUES (1, 'FOOD', 1000, 100) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
SELECT rolling_volume FROM port_commodity_state WHERE port_id=1 AND commodity_code='FOOD'
SELECT stock_level FROM port_commodity_state WHERE port_id=1 AND commodity_code='FOOD'

tests.name: Cluster pressure decay when enabled
tests.description: Pressure should decay multiplicatively and be clamped

args.query: INSERT INTO cluster_commodity_pressure (cluster_id, commodity_code, pressure, rolling_volume) VALUES ($1, 'ORE', 5000, 500) ON CONFLICT (cluster_id, commodity_code) DO UPDATE SET pressure=5000, rolling_volume=500
SELECT pressure, rolling_volume FROM cluster_commodity_pressure WHERE cluster_id=$1 AND commodity_code='ORE'

tests.name: Two decay cycles are multiplicative
tests.description: Running decay twice should equal floor(floor(x*98/100)*98/100)

args.query: INSERT INTO port_commodity_state (port_id, commodity_code, rolling_volume, stock_level) VALUES (2, 'WATER', 10000, 0) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
SELECT rolling_volume FROM port_commodity_state WHERE port_id=2 AND commodity_code='WATER'
SELECT rolling_volume FROM port_commodity_state WHERE port_id=2 AND commodity_code='WATER'

tests.name: Cluster pressure clamping
tests.description: Cluster pressure should clamp to configured bounds

steps.desc: Seed pressure beyond clamp (1000000, will clamp to max)

args.query: INSERT INTO cluster_commodity_pressure (cluster_id, commodity_code, pressure, rolling_volume) VALUES ($1, 'LOOT', 1000000, 100) ON CONFLICT (cluster_id, commodity_code) DO UPDATE SET pressure=1000000
SELECT pressure FROM cluster_commodity_pressure WHERE cluster_id=$1 AND commodity_code='LOOT'

steps.desc: Verify pressure clamped to max (50000 by default)

tests.name: Negative pressure (supply signal) decays toward zero
tests.description: Negative pressure should decay multiplicatively and clamp to min

args.query: INSERT INTO cluster_commodity_pressure (cluster_id, commodity_code, pressure, rolling_volume) VALUES ($1, 'METAL', -1000, 50) ON CONFLICT (cluster_id, commodity_code) DO UPDATE SET pressure=-1000
SELECT pressure FROM cluster_commodity_pressure WHERE cluster_id=$1 AND commodity_code='METAL'

description: Runs market decay through the real persisted engine scheduler; canonical ORE/ORG/EQU codes only.

tests.name: A1 setup: disabled-decay fixture with canonical ORE

sql: INSERT INTO config(key,value,type) VALUES ('market.dynamic_pricing_enabled','false','bool') ON CONFLICT(key) DO UPDATE SET value=EXCLUDED.value,type=EXCLUDED.type;

INSERT INTO cron_tasks(name,schedule,last_run_at,next_due_at,enabled,payload) VALUES ('market_state_decay','daily@23:59Z',NULL,CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,TRUE,NULL) ON CONFLICT(name) DO UPDATE SET schedule='daily@23:59Z',next_due_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,enabled=TRUE;
INSERT INTO port_commodity_state(port_id,commodity_code,rolling_volume,stock_level) VALUES (1,'ORE',1000,100) ON CONFLICT(port_id,commodity_code) DO UPDATE SET rolling_volume=1000,stock_level=100;

data.sql: SELECT rolling_volume FROM port_commodity_state WHERE port_id=1 AND commodity_code='ORE';

tests.name: Enable deterministic scheduler for market decay acceptance

data.sql: INSERT INTO config(key,value,type) VALUES ('test.deterministic_scheduler_enabled','1','int') ON CONFLICT(key) DO UPDATE SET value='1',type='int';

tests.name: A1 schedule: make the real decay task due
A1 choose deterministic scheduler time
A1 execute real market decay handler
A1 verify: disabled dynamic pricing preserves market state

data.sql: SELECT rolling_volume FROM port_commodity_state WHERE port_id=1 AND commodity_code='ORE';

tests.name: Seed B-F: canonical commodities and deterministic pressure values

sql: INSERT INTO config(key,value,type) VALUES ('market.dynamic_pricing_enabled','true','bool') ON CONFLICT(key) DO UPDATE SET value=EXCLUDED.value,type=EXCLUDED.type;

INSERT INTO cron_tasks(name,schedule,last_run_at,next_due_at,enabled,payload) VALUES ('market_state_decay','daily@23:59Z',NULL,CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,TRUE,NULL) ON CONFLICT(name) DO UPDATE SET schedule='daily@23:59Z',next_due_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,enabled=TRUE;

INSERT INTO port_commodity_state(port_id,commodity_code,rolling_volume,stock_level) VALUES (1,'ORG',1000,100),(2,'EQU',10000,0) ON CONFLICT(port_id,commodity_code) DO UPDATE SET rolling_volume=EXCLUDED.rolling_volume,stock_level=EXCLUDED.stock_level;

INSERT INTO cluster_commodity_pressure(cluster_id,commodity_code,pressure,rolling_volume) SELECT MIN(clusters_id),'ORE',5000,500 FROM clusters HAVING COUNT(*)>0 ON CONFLICT(cluster_id,commodity_code) DO UPDATE SET pressure=5000,rolling_volume=500;

INSERT INTO cluster_commodity_pressure(cluster_id,commodity_code,pressure,rolling_volume) SELECT MIN(clusters_id),'ORG',1000000,100 FROM clusters HAVING COUNT(*)>0 ON CONFLICT(cluster_id,commodity_code) DO UPDATE SET pressure=1000000,rolling_volume=100;

INSERT INTO cluster_commodity_pressure(cluster_id,commodity_code,pressure,rolling_volume) SELECT MIN(clusters_id),'EQU',-5000,100 FROM clusters HAVING COUNT(*)>0 ON CONFLICT(cluster_id,commodity_code) DO UPDATE SET pressure=-5000,rolling_volume=100;
